title: Raku Firing Workshops
cost_text: $25/person + $18/load (up to 9" tall); add $6 per additional 4.5"h up to max 22"ht and 13"wide. Bisque firing fees separate.
how_to_join: Call or email the studio to participate
source_quote: Raku Firings are by appointment on Weekends from 12:00 - 4:00 pm at a minimum cost of $25/person + $18 (per load; more for tall items). 2 person minimum.
evidence_sentence: Raku firings are offered by appointment on weekends; potters bring bisque-fired items and pay per person and load.
summary: Midnight Potter Studios offers raku firings by appointment on weekend afternoons for $25/person plus $18 per load. Bring bisque-fired pieces; items must be bisque fired before the raku day. All participants (including visitors) must sign a waiver and pay the fee.
